column1: # Rules in omp-port/rules.sed whose left side holds `.*` or `.+`, one per line as
# `left-hand-fragment<TAB>sha256<TAB>reason`. A wildcard swallows whatever upstream writes inside
# its span, so a sentence upstream adds there disappears with no rule changing. The sha256 covers
# every span the rule's own left side matches in raw upstream, sorted, one per line, and `swallow
# ledger` fails the day that text changes, printing what moved. Read the new text, then narrow the
# rule or record the new hash with why dropping it is right. The fragment is matched as a literal
# substring of the rule's own line, as in stale-exempt.tsv.
